prova:
intro m hm
  use SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin (m ^ 2))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    rw [SimpleGraph.cliqueSizes_completeGraph] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.ncard_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h1 : 2 ≤ m := hm
    have h2 : (m : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have h_ineq : (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 2 - 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      linarith [h2]
    exact h_ineq
  · simp only [SimpleGraph.cliqueTransversalNumber_completeGraph, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow,
      Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h1 : 2 ≤ m := hm
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := rel_of_ineq_and_pow -- wait, simple norm_num or linarith with pow
    -- Let's just use Omega or norm_cast for 2 <= m^2 when m >= 2.
    have h_m2 : 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast h_m2
